import asyncio, os
from telethon import TelegramClient
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv()
client = TelegramClient('/root/my-bot/user_session', int(os.getenv('TELEGRAM_API_ID')), os.getenv('TELEGRAM_API_HASH'))
async def main():
    await client.start()
    async for d in client.iter_dialogs(limit=300):
        if any(x in (d.name or '').lower() for x in ['даш','даня','dasha','доч']):
            print(d.name, d.id)
    await client.disconnect()
asyncio.run(main())
